written.myAnswer: ATP means adenosine triphosphate and ADP means adenosine diphosphate. ATP stores and transfers usable energy. When ATP loses a phosphate group and becomes ADP, energy is released for cellular processes. Energy from food is used to combine ADP with inorganic phosphate (Pi) to form ATP.

ATP (adenosine triphosphate) is a nucleotide made of adenine, ribose and three phosphate groups. Energy is stored in its phosphate bonds. When the terminal phosphate separates as inorganic phosphate, ATP becomes ADP and releases energy for cellular processes. Cells use energy from food to reform ATP from ADP and Pi, so ATP transfers energy between metabolic reactions.
